treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Kingdom of Denmark and the Government of the State of Israel for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income, with Protocol (2009)
eif_quote: Overenskomsten trådte i medfør af artikel 29 i kraft den 29. december 2011. (BKI nr. 2 af 05.01.2012); skat.dk: 29.12.2011 | Virkning 01.01.2012
source_title: Bekendtgørelse nr. 2 af 5. januar 2012 (Lovtidende C) – DBO Danmark–Israel (Danish/English)

rates.quote: a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends where such holding is being possessed for an uninterrupted period of no less than one year and the dividends are declared within that period;
d) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.basis: treaty art. 27(1) (Limitation of Benefits main-purpose rule); MLI art. 7(1) also applies per treaty map from 2020-01-01
ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the provisions of any other Article of this Convention, a resident of a Contracting State shall not receive the benefit of any reduction in or exemption from tax provided for in the Convention by the other Contracting State if the main purpose or one of the main purposes of a transaction or an act done by such resident or a person connected with such resident was to obtain the benefits of the Convention.

notes: Dividends: 0% also for the other State, its central bank or government-owned/controlled agencies (Art. 10(2)(b)) and for recognised pension funds (Art. 10(2)(c)); 0% company tier requires >=10% direct holding for an uninterrupted period of at least one year (modelled as 365 days). Protocol 1: Israeli REIT distributions to Danish residents fall under Art. 6, not Art. 10. Interest: exempt (Art. 11(3)) when paid to a resident pension fund, on listed corporate bonds of a resident issuer, to the Government/subdivision/local authority/Central Bank on loans granted by them, or on debt guaranteed/insured by a wholly state-owned export-credit institution; Art. 11(2)(b) election for net taxation. Protocol 3: relief conditioned on a residence certificate. Art. 29(2): effective for income years following the EIF year (from 2012). MLI: both Parties cover the treaty (treaty map: MLI WHT effect 2020-01-01); synthesised text not obtained, so MLI modifications (incl. any Art. 8) not verified.
